body.name: Width-two injective deterministic-path projection
body.construction:
For \(b\le2\), set \(T^{\mathrm{proj}}=(W^{\mathrm{proj}},A^{\mathrm{proj}})\) using Definitions~\ref{def:transition-vertices}--\ref{def:transition-arcs}.  Order its internal vertices by the type and endpoint tuple of their edge labels under \(\prec\).  A search state consists of an induced directed prefix \(P=(\sigma=v_0,\ldots,v_k)\) and a surviving induced subgraph \(H\) containing \(v_k\) and \(t\).  Initially \(P=(\sigma)\) and \(H=T^{\mathrm{proj}}\).  For each out-neighbor \(w\) of \(v_k\) in \(H\), in the fixed order, set
\[
 H_w=H-\bigl(\{v_k\}\cup(N_H^+(v_k)\setminus\{w\})\bigr).
\]
Create the child \((P\cdot w,H_w)\) exactly when \(t\) is reachable from \(w\) in \(H_w\).  On reaching \(t\), emit \(L(P)\).  Depth-first traversal of these children is the width-two projected enumerator.
